column4: White-hot thermal, warm figures with heads and moving limbs, flashes, orbit, reticle, telemetry; green NV cams with grain. IR strobes blink on the NV cams only (a thermal camera cannot see them); the drone uses Blue Force Tracker boxes instead.
ISR feed conventions (white hot, telemetry, track box, grid) drawn in drawDrone; plan-then-watch as in the references.
2D top-down sensor view with drag slew, wheel zoom, slow orbit; first-person helmet-cam panels.
Drag/arrow slew, wheel/+- zoom, orbit (index.html:371), click or Tab to track; people under roofs are not drawn (droneSees).
Raycast green NV from A-1, B-1, C-1 helmets (index.html:948), keys 1-4 or click to make one the main feed.
GFC phase machine: infil, isolate, breach, clear rooms with two elements, SSE, exfil (gfc, clearTick at index.html:684).
Gate 1 at the release point and gate 2 before the breach; G/W/X or buttons; WAIT re-asks after waitAsk; contact adds a third gate.
Dog barks at moving soldiers, someone climbs to the roof to look (index.html:457), guards fight, family hides, target flees when warned (index.html:527).
present / nextdoor / setup drawn from the seed with weights in config.js; setup puts three fighters on the north roof.
R then click: reserve mounts its truck and blocks; I sends the nearest of B, C or R after the tracked person (index.html:765).
Muzzle flashes on both feeds (index.html:567), hits as WIA/KIA lying figures, after-action screen (index.html:1182).
Thermal drone feed in the slice.
Helmet cams in the slice.
Go, wait and abort in the slice.
Clock starts 02:30:00L.
Teams walk from the trucks in file (staggered starts, index.html:331); strobes blink on the NV cams.
The dog barks when soldiers move within dogHear; GFC reports it.
At the release point the GFC asks GO to isolate.
Two men awake by the gate, one with a glowing cigarette ember; a rifle is the only tell between the guard and the nephew (index.html spawn).
G answers GO.
B and C move round the walls to the corners and alley mouths.
Marker line in the brief with no content of its own.
Truth chosen by the seed; ?truth= forces one for testing.
Waiting: random waking, dog barks bring someone up on the roof, and the target moves on by himself between leaveMin and leaveMax. No phone call is modelled.
A runner can be tracked and intercepted; the nearest of B, C or R goes, so a cordon team leaving opens its side.
Debrief counts the target result, friendly, civilian and enemy casualties, detainees and time.
Marker line in the brief with no content of its own.
Plan panel (drop-off, entry, cordon, reserve, abort criteria), threat marks, no-go, back-brief with approve or revise (index.html:860); clock runs from 01:45.
Raid planning and back-brief in the slice.
